description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Umbral Mantle ability.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.
